headline: Dollar Rises to R$ 5.22 on Risk Aversion Amid Oil Price Escalation
summary: The dollar rose to R$5.22 amid risk aversion linked to escalating oil prices. Investors were also focused on a new Datafolha poll and a televised presidential debate.
why: The real is Brazil's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect inflation, import costs and foreign investment returns.
why_moved: The report cites risk aversion tied to escalating oil prices. Ahead of the evening, investors were also watching the Datafolha poll and a presidential debate.
